brief: PCE and Fed Governor Williams reduced October rate-hike odds from 70% Monday to 37% the next day, yet the 10Y yield still rose about 6bp on the day via bear steepening, which JPM reads as a growth repricing rather than an inflation scare. JPM moved from Cautious/Neutral (set Aug 31) to Tactically Bullish, dropping its paired +NDX/-RTY trade for an outright Tech long via derivatives given squeeze risk, arguing bond yields should stabilize (Jay Barry: 10Y to 5.20% next month, 5.05% by year-end) while 26Q3 EPS growth consensus near 29% looks too low against resilient spending and improving labor data. Separately, credit strategist Saul Doctor's Fear and Greed Index breached its oversold trigger (83 vs. 80), as CDS spreads widened on rising rate volatility (TLT implied vol 10% to 15%); he calls this bullish because CDX.IG's three-month time value (30c) would recoup a full retrace to year-to-date wides within three months. Micron's print was strong but the stock reversed from up 4% to negative intraday on unresolved questions over F2H27 capex size and capital-return timing. August core PCE rose 0.25% m/m, with the year-on-year rate at 3.01%, below JPM's 3.28% forecast.
